camel_example: aliyun dcdn DescribeDcdnDomainQpsDataByLayer --region cn-hangzhou --IspNameEn telecom --EndTime '2015-12-10T21:00:00Z' --DomainName 'example.com' --LocationNameEn hangzhou --StartTime '2015-12-10T20:00:00Z' --Layer all --Interval 300
description_en: Queries the queries per second (QPS) of accelerated domain names by protocol
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainQpsDataByLayer按协议查询域名的每秒访问次数QPS
kebab_example: aliyun dcdn describe-dcdn-domain-qps-data-by-layer --domain-name example.com --start-time 2015-12-10T20:00:00Z --end-time 2015-12-10T21:00:00Z --interval 300 --isp-name-en telecom --location-name-en hangzhou --layer all --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDcdnDomainQpsDataByLayer

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain names to be queried. You can specify multiple domain names and separate them with commas (,). You can specify up to 500 domain names. The data of multiple domain names is aggregated and returned. If this parameter is left empty, the aggregated data of all accelerated domain names is returned by default
parameters.help_zh:
需要查询的加速域名。支持批量域名查询，多个域名用半角逗号（,）分隔，最多支持500个域名，多个域名会按照聚合结果进行输出。
若参数为空，默认返回所有加速域名合并后的数据
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The start time of the data to be queried. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. The minimum data granularity is 5 minutes. If this parameter is not specified, the data of the last 24 hours is queried by default
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据起始时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。
最小数据粒度为5分钟。
不写默认读取过去24小时数据
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the data to be queried. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据结束时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The time granularity of the data to be queried. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 300 (5 minutes), 3600 (1 hour), and 86400 (1 day). The supported values vary based on the maximum time span of a single query. For more information, see the Supported time granularities for queries section
parameters.help_zh:
指定查询数据的时间粒度，单位：秒。

根据单次查询的最大时间跨度不同，该参数支持300（5分钟）、3600（1小时）和86400（1天）取值，具体请参见使用说明中支持查询的时间粒度
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en: The English name of the Internet service provider (ISP). You can call the [DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp](~~DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp~~) operation to query ISPs. If you do not specify this parameter, all ISPs are queried
parameters.help_zh: 运营商英文名，通过[DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp](~~DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp~~)接口获得，不传值代表所有运营商
parameters.name: isp_name_en

parameters.help_en: The English name of the region. You can call the [DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp](~~DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp~~) operation to query regions. If you do not specify this parameter, all regions are queried
parameters.help_zh: 区域英文名，通过[DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp](~~DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp~~)接口获得，不传值代表所有区域
parameters.name: location_name_en

parameters.help_en: The query dimension. Valid values: network layer (IPv4 and IPv6), application layer (HTTP, HTTPS, and QUIC), and all. Default value: all
parameters.help_zh:
查询维度，可选网络层（IPv4、IPv6）或应用层（http、https、quic）或all。
默认为all
parameters.name: layer

DataInterval.description_en: The time interval of each record. Unit: seconds
DataInterval.description_zh: 每条记录的时间间隔，单位：秒

EndTime.description_en: The end time. The time is displayed in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is in UTC
EndTime.description_zh:
结束时间。

时间采用 ISO 8601 格式的 UTC 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

StartTime.description_en: The start time. The time is displayed in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is in UTC
StartTime.description_zh:
开始时间。

时间采用 ISO 8601 格式的 UTC 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
